description: Figure 3 is a grouped bar chart titled "Results of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev." It compares the performance of two logical synthesis modules, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four categories of query difficulty: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical y-axis is labeled "Execution Accuracy" and ranges from 20 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal x-axis lists the four difficulty categories. For each category, two bars are displayed: a light blue bar representing NatSQL and a dark blue bar representing TA-SQL. The specific accuracy values are labeled above each bar. For Simple queries, NatSQL achieves 60.21 and TA-SQL achieves 63.14. For Moderate queries, NatSQL scores 39.64 and TA-SQL scores 48.60. For Challenging queries, NatSQL scores 32.32 and TA-SQL scores 36.11. For the Total score, NatSQL achieves 51.35 and TA-SQL achieves 56.19. The chart visually demonstrates that TA-SQL outperforms NatSQL in all four categories.
